_doc: Motedis' end cap for 20 mm B-type profiles (PTS6B20x20): a black plastic plate 20 x 20 mm with a cross that presses into the centre bore and a lug into a slot. No screws. Sizes from Motedis' drawing, the price from its shop page.
name: fitting-motedis-end-cap-20-b6
